on the Ornn Compute Price Index, as of September 1, 2026. The value settles once per trading day by 20:00 UTC.</p></div><div class=\"mb-10\"><h2 class=\"mb-3 text-xl font-medium text-[var(--text-primary)] font-[family-name:var(--font-title)]\">How is the Ornn Compute Price Index calculated?</h2><p class=\"text-[15px] leading-[1.75] text-[var(--text-secondary)]\">Each OCPI value is a volume-weighted, winsorized average of transacted GPU rental prices across the neocloud market — real trades between buyers and sellers, not scraped listings, provider rate cards, or survey estimates. It settles once per trading day and is listed on Bloomberg. The universe, calculation, governance and revision policy are published in full in the OCPI methodology.</p></div><div class=\"mb-10\"><h2 class=\"mb-3 text-xl font-medium text-[var(--text-primary)] font-[family-name:var(--font-title)]\">What GPU price data is free without an API key?</h2><p class=\"text-[15px] leading-[1.75] text-[var(--text-secondary)]\">The latest settled value and three months of daily history for 5 GPUs — H100 SXM, H200, B200, A100 SXM4, RTX 5090 — plus four OTPI token labs. No account and no key are required for any of it. Full history back to inception, hourly grain, CSV exports and the complete neocloud map require a subscription.</p></div><p class=\"text-[15px] leading-[1.75] text-[var(--text-tertiary)]\">Full
